name: boundary/projector Hperp zero
formula: q-basic projector + q-owned/fixed domain + no wall/denominator + differentiability-owned no-flux boundary => Dq_boundary_projector[Hperp]=0 => epsilon_boundary_projector=0

name: domain/projector fallback
formula: epsilon_boundary_projector <= R_P_metric + R_domain + R_Hodge_readout + R_wall + R_denominator + R_source_readout + R_diff_owner + R_corner_edge + R_rad_flux + R_source_crossing + R_memory_pullback + R_improvement

name: EDq component update
formula: E_Dq,Hperp^2 := sum_{i!=tau,boundary_projector} w_i epsilon_i^2 in the locked no-flux branch; otherwise include w_boundary epsilon_boundary_projector^2

name: source-support handoff
formula: N_src_nonHilbert <= ||U_B||_inf(C_S C_perp E_Dq,Hperp + ||R_src_readout||), with boundary contribution removed only in the q-basic no-flux branch
